description: This file implements a class 'ModeSet' for managing DRM (Direct Rendering Manager) display modes, including device initialization, buffer creation, surface management, and page flipping for Raspberry Pi 4. It interacts with DRM, GBM, and related libraries to set up and control display output.

classes.name: ModeSet
classes.description: A class managing DRM display mode setup, buffer creation, and page flipping on Raspberry Pi 4.

methods.name: ModeSet
methods.description: Constructor that initializes DRM device, finds display, creates buffer, and sets mode.

methods.name: Destruct
methods.description: Cleans up resources such as buffers, device, and closes file descriptor.

methods.name: Width
methods.description: Returns width of the current buffer.

methods.name: Height
methods.description: Returns height of the current buffer.

methods.name: CreateRenderTarget
methods.description: Creates a GBM surface for rendering.

methods.name: AddSurfaceToOutput
methods.description: Locks front buffer of GBM surface, creates framebuffer, and returns its ID.

methods.name: ScanOutRenderTarget
methods.description: Performs page flip to display the buffer and handles event loop.
